title: Bias-aware BiLSTM toxicity classifier
summary: The solution lowercases comments, splits words and punctuation, truncates to 220 tokens, and builds a training-only vocabulary of up to 200,000 tokens occurring at least twice. It encodes texts with padding and length-bucketed batches. A randomly initialized 300-dimensional embedding with spatial dropout feeds two stacked bidirectional LSTMs. Masked mean and max pooling are concatenated, passed through two residual ReLU linear layers, and used for toxicity and identity-attribute logits. Training uses weighted toxicity binary cross-entropy, upweighting subgroup and label/subgroup mismatch cases, plus masked binary cross-entropy for identity auxiliary targets. It runs Adam with cosine-decayed learning rate, mixed precision, gradient scaling, and norm clipping. Five seeded models are trained for four epochs; validation predictions from epochs 1 onward are snapshot-ensembled by mean probability. Inference applies sigmoid to toxicity logits and averages the selected snapshots.
